attributes.board_name: Utah Division of Professional Licensing (DOPL) - Physicians Licensing Board

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 34 hours ACCME Category 1; up to 6 hours from the Division; up to 15% for documented volunteer health care (1 credit per 4 hours); credit in 50-minute hour blocks
rules.alternatives: Participation in an AOA- or ACCME-approved residency meets the requirement pro rata for the part of the cycle.
rules.audit_note: Keep documentation proving compliance for 2 years after the end of the licensure cycle (R156-67-304(4)).

topics.who: Controlled substance prescribers (Utah CS license, Schedule II/III opioid/hypnotic/stimulant authority); AMA PRA Category 1 classes approved by DOPL with post-course assessment

Controlled substance prescribers: one-time SBIRT (Screening, Brief Intervention, Referral to Treatment) class for licensing periods beginning after Jan 1, 2024; it also satisfies the 3.5 h prescribing requirement for that period
All physicians: at least one of the DOPL online suicide prevention trainings (0.5 credit each), listed as a renewal requirement

rules.notes: Licensed by DOPL with the Physicians Licensing Board. Licenses expire January 31 of even years. Controlled substance CE statute was renumbered from 58-37-6.5 (still cited on the DOPL page) to 58-37-303. Fee: see DOPL fee schedule.
rules.legal_basis: Utah Admin. Code R156-67-304; Utah Code 58-67-304; Utah Code 58-37-303
